characterTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet of SUBJECT from One Piece. APPEARANCE. Match the supplied Shanks reference's chibi pixel-art style, crisp dark pixel outlines, shaded colors, oversized head and compact body. Reference is STYLE AND GRID ONLY, never copy Shanks's features. True transparent alpha background. EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, twelve separate full-body sprites, no overlap. Row 1: four distinct sleeping-on-side breathing frames. Row 2: four distinct walking-right cycle frames with visibly alternating legs. Row 3: four sitting cross-legged attention frames with subtle blinking and head movement. Consistent character size across all twelve frames. Each pose completely inside its cell with ample transparent padding and bottom alignment. Landscape sheet 4:3. No labels, text except specified costume lettering, grid, ground, shadow, scenery, checkerboard, or extra characters. Intended for clean downsampling to 56px tall.

shipTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet of SUBJECT from One Piece. APPEARANCE. Match the supplied Red Force reference's chibi pixel-art style, crisp dark outlines, shaded colors and compact proportions. Reference is STYLE AND GRID ONLY, do not copy its dragon figurehead or architecture. True transparent alpha background. EXACTLY 4 equal columns and ONE row, four separate complete ship sprites in a wide landscape strip. All four show the same ship and same three-quarter side view, bow pointing left, with subtle differing bob, flag and rigging movement to form four animation frames. The entire ship including all masts and bow must fit within each cell with generous transparent padding. No ocean, water, ground, shadow, scenery, text labels, grid or checkerboard. Distinct readable silhouette intended for 116px wide display.

edits.prompt: Edit only the pirate emblems on this Oro Jackson sprite sheet. The central skull must be Gol D. Roger's emblem: a bare white skull with a long bold curved black handlebar mustache and white crossed bones. Remove ALL hats from ALL skulls. NO straw hat and NO red headband anywhere. Preserve the exact ship, four-column single-row grid, transparency, red striped sails, egg, mermaids and cannons. Do not alter anything outside the emblems.
